Choosing between chat SDKs for mobile apps comes down to platform coverage, moderation tools, pricing model and how much control you keep over the interface.

## How we evaluated these chat SDKs

We compared each option on the same five criteria: supported platforms, built-in moderation, pricing model, UI control and data ownership. Disclosure: social.plus publishes this blog and is one of the products listed, so we applied the criteria to it in exactly the same way.

## Chat SDKs for mobile apps at a glance

| SDK | Platforms | Moderation | Pricing model |
|---|---|---|---|
| Option A | iOS, Android, web | Built-in | Per monthly active user |
| Option B | iOS, Android | Add-on | Per connection |
| social.plus | iOS, Android, web, Flutter, React Native | Built-in | Per monthly active user |

## Which option fits which team?

Teams that need the widest platform coverage should shortlist options that ship native and cross-platform kits. Teams with strict moderation needs should favour built-in tooling over add-ons.
